hypothesis: Reservation takes a lock via Modules.LOCKING, which defaults to the in-memory provider. With two servers on one database, each process has its own lock, so two completions of carts that each need the single SOLO unit can both reserve it at once. Expect a live reservation sum of 2 against stock 1, failing no_oversell (and likely reserved_matches_reservations is unaffected since both counters are written consistently).
submitted_scenario:
schema: oversold.scenario/v1
name: solo-two-servers
description: Two carts each need the single SOLO unit and are completed at the same time on two servers.
target:
  engine: medusa
  version: 2.22.0
  servers: 2
stock:
  SOLO: 1
carts:
  alice:
    server: 1
    lines:
    - sku: OVS-SOLO
      qty: 1
  bob:
    server: 2
    lines:
    - sku: OVS-SOLO
      qty: 1
race:
- id: alice-completes
  server: 1
  do: complete
  cart: alice
- id: bob-completes
  server: 2
  do: complete
  cart: bob
timing:
  release: together
  jitter_ms:
  - 0
  - 3
  request_timeout_ms: 30000
faults: []
runs: 20
seed: 7
